Chapter 6505: Destroy The World

Chapter 6505: Destroy The World

“Die, all die!” The heart devil had taken over Seventy-two’s mind. No one in this world deserved to be spared in his eyes.

He finally opened the tube large enough to release the remnant flame. Not much was left after Poye’s usage previously.

Nonetheless, it came from Poye’s master who was rumored to be a true immortal. Despite the lack of fanfare and blinding visuals, space and time started melting in Old World.

The sky and the stars turned to ashes, leaving an empty void. No laws survived the onslaught and everything collapsed.

The first major lineages to go down included Seventy-two Skyraiser Sect, Trinity, and Immortal Gate. The flame’s temperature melted them into an ocean of lava.

This was only the prologue since Old World became unstable, on the verge of collapsing into a single point. It would be as if the world had never existed. The glorious and prosperous past was no different than a dream.

“Noo!” Everyone was scared out of their mind, feeling powerless regardless of their cultivation.

“Good, good!” Seventy-two laughed and felt amazing as this was his moment of revenge. Although he was going to die as well, he took this wretched world down with him.

“Buzz.” A primordial light emerged in all corners of the dying world, illuminating even the smallest speck of dust.

The temporal affinity appeared again and expanded from the singularity. Time reversed and everyone felt them coming back from the ashes. This applied to the land as well.

The reversal stopped once the flame returned to the tube. Living beings somehow lost their support and fell to the ground, primal ancestors and heavenslayers included.

This world was dead and had reverted to a singularity. They still didn’t forget the sensation and fear caused by the flame. This was engraved into their soul.

The only explanation they had was that this was just a short dream. Of course, top cultivators understood everything was real.

“A temporal reversal applied to the whole world.” A primal ancestor murmured.

This was shocking because temporal reversal could happen during a fight between true masters. However, this was confined to themselves and their techniques.

In this case, it affected Old World and brought it back from destruction.
